reviews.title: Amazing monitor. Annoying issue.
reviews.comment:
Great monitor for the price. I got it at a small sale for black Friday so it was very worth in my opinion. The colors are very vibrant and the specs in the spec sheet match up well with what’s in the box. It’s a true upgrade going from 1080p to 1440p and that can’t truly be understood until it’s seen in person. The stand is also pretty decent. Has height and angle variation, and is pretty easy to install. It is however, very wobbly on my desk since i have a less sturdy desk but all in all it’s not too bad.
Now the reason I gave this one star off from 5 is because I have a dual monitor arm from vivo and it does not fit out of the box into the mount on the arm. The CUNPU monitor vesa mount is recessed AND there isn’t enough space between the top screw holes and the side of the mount wall. Unfortunately this means I can’t use the mount I have which is a big let down because I bought the arm just for this reason. I also live in a country outside the US so I can’t return it easily.
Just a forewarning for anyone buying this monitor; make sure your monitor arm or any other mounting device can properly fit, or just get another monitor with proper vesa mount
reviews.author: TRINICOOLMAN

reviews.title: Exceptional quality gaming monitor, at an exceptional price
reviews.comment: This gaming monitor is absolutely fantastic, especially at that exceptional price,  it performs magnificently. The screen is sharp and bright as can be all the way to the edges. The controls are easily managed. I’m actually in the process of purchasing two more for flight swimming, which is my favorite thing to do. The scenery visuals while operating any of my flight programs are nothing short of spectacular!  The images are ‘photo-real’, 3D-like, and seem to pop right out of the screen!  Nicely done CUNPU…Nicely done!!!  Cheers!!!😍😍😍
